name: point-hacks-copilot
description: Point Hacks Copilot — AU credit-card eligibility & optimisation. Mobile-first web app (M0+M1 milestone). See docs/ for PRD.

pnpm._comment: pnpm 10 blocks install scripts for nested packages by default (security). Whitelist any package whose postinstall must run — sharp needs it to fetch platform-specific native binaries (was breaking @capacitor/assets in CI with 'Cannot find module sharp-darwin-arm64v8.node'). Expand this list if a build step fails saying a native module is missing.

_comment_lint-staged: ESLint deliberately not in the pre-commit hook: workspaces use incompatible ESLint majors (root v10, apps/web v9 pinned by eslint-config-next). CI runs `pnpm lint` per-workspace which resolves the right binary. Re-add when eslint-config-next supports v10.
